noAccess.title: Your role may not see the help calls
noAccess.body: Your role does not include “production.calls.view”. Ask an administrator if you need this page.

page.editRouting: Edit who is called (Floor rules & codes)

tile.medianHint: From sent to seen, today's calls of the site: never a person's figure.

held.noAnswer: Your role may not answer help calls (production.calls.answer).
held.ackNone: Select the open calls nobody has seen yet.
held.ackNothing: None of the selected calls waits to be seen.
held.solveNothing: None of the selected calls is open.
held.noSettings: Your role may not open Floor rules & codes (production.settings.view).
held.seenAlready: Someone has seen this call already.
held.comingAlready: Someone is on the way already.
held.outcomeNamed: What this call led to is named already.
held.noPlantJobs: Opening a maintenance job needs plant.view and plant.jobs.manage.
held.code: Pick one of the codes offered.
held.reason: Say why the call is cancelled.

chart.title: Calls by hour · {site}
chart.noSite: Pick a site in the top bar to see its calls by hour.
chart.label: Help calls today at {site}, per hour
chart.caption_one: {count} call today. Stations send a call with one tap; nobody is counted by name.
chart.caption_other: {count} calls today. Stations send a call with one tap; nobody is counted by name.

none.title: No calls today
none.body: When a station calls for help, its hour shows here.

chart.responsesHint: From sent to seen, per type of call today: a call's time, never a person's.

routing.title: Who is called
routing.noSite: Pick a site in the top bar to see who is called there.

none.title: No help-call types at this site
none.body: Add them in Floor rules & codes › Help-call routing: each type goes to a team.

routing.hint: A call goes to its group's bells and tablets at once. Changed in Floor rules & codes.

list.label: Help calls
list.title: Help calls
list.failed: The calls could not be read

noMatch.title: No call matches
noMatch.body: Clear the filters or the search to see every open call.

empty.title: No open calls ✓
empty.body: Every station has what it needs. A new call shows here at once.

person.workerHidden: A floor team member (this site records stations, not people)

waiting.hint: While the call is open, the station's time books to an off-standard code: the waiting never counts against the worker.
waiting.banner: The station's waiting books to {code} ({status}) while the call is open: it never counts against the worker.

detail.title: {type} · {line} · {station}
detail.notFound: This call does not exist, or it belongs to a site your role does not reach.
detail.callerHint: Named because this site's floor records name workers.
detail.legal: These are this call's times. Response times are never shown, grouped or totalled by person.

solve.title: Mark the call solved
solve.body: The station sees it solved at once; the call's times are kept.
solve.bodyN_one: {count} call gets the same code and words; a call someone changed meanwhile is told apart.
solve.bodyN_other: The {count} calls get the same code and words; a call someone changed meanwhile is told apart.
solve.codeHint: Optional: it helps to see what calls are about.
solve.noteHint: Optional. Never about a person's work.

cancel.title: Cancel this call?
cancel.body: The station's call closes without help. The station can send a new one.
cancel.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with the change.

job.title: Open a maintenance job
job.body: A corrective job for the machine at this station; the call then names it as what it led to.
job.noMachine: No machine is recorded at this station.
job.toPlant: Open the job from Plant › Maintenance jobs
job.problemHint: What the technician needs to know. No names.

notice.coming_one: The station sees that you are on the way.
notice.coming_other: The stations see that you are on the way.
notice.partly: {done} done, {refused} not: someone changed them meanwhile or they are closed. The list is read again.
notice.job: Maintenance job {number} is open and linked to the call.

refusal.ALREADY_SEEN: Someone has seen this call already: say you are on the way, or mark it solved.
refusal.ALREADY_ON_THE_WAY: Someone is on the way to this call already: read the call again to see who.
refusal.OUTCOME_NAMED: What this call led to is named already: open that record from the call.
refusal.KIND_FIXED: A call type keeps its kind: switch it off and add a new one with the other kind.
refusal.CODE_TAKEN: The site has a help-call type with this code already.
refusal.CODE_NOT_LISTED: This is not an active code of the help-call reasons: add it there first.
refusal.TEAM_NOT_ACTIVE: This team is archived or works at another site.
refusal.WAITING_CODE: The waiting time books to an active off-standard code of the company.
refusal.TYPE_INACTIVE: This kind of call is switched off at the site.
refusal.NOT_THIS_STATION: Only the station that sent this call closes it there.
refusal.NO_STATION: The tablet stands at no station.
refusal.OTHER_STATION: Only a team leader calls for another station.

problem.read: The server didn’t answer as expected. Try again.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: The call changed meanwhile: it is read again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this at this site.
problem.gone: This call no longer exists, or your role does not reach its site.
problem.invalid: Something was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again.
